Name: System ID
notes: One row per system. Do not store systems as columns.

Name: System Type
type: enum (Forge World, Hive, Agri, Civilised, Fortress, Knight World, Death World, Dead World, Mining, Shrine, Warp Rift, Void Station, Fleet Anchorage)

Name: Power Level
notes: Strategic value. Suggested range 1-5. Winner typically gains this many campaign points.

Name: Loyalist Level
notes: Influence 0-10. Raise after Loyalist wins here; lower after losses.

Name: Traitor Level
notes: Influence 0-10. Same as loyalist level for the other side.

Name: Neutrality Modifier
notes: Resistance to flipping. Subtract from influence gains if you want stubborn worlds.

Name: Controller
notes: Who currently holds the map node. Contested if both levels are equal and greater than 0. Unaligned if both are 0 (or Blackshield-held).

Name: Infrastructure
type: array of enum (Shipyard, Titan Forge, Manufactorum, Spaceport, Bastion, Void Shield, Warp Beacon, Knight Keep)
notes: Comma-separated in Sheets. Empty means undeveloped.

Name: Warp Links
notes: Comma-separated destination system ids. No 3-link cap. Treat links as two-way unless you note otherwise.

Name: Notes
example: Dark Mechanicum treaties. Orbital shipyards still intact.
notes: Special rules and lore. Do not store occupying forces here; derive them from db_forces.sys_id.

Name: System Durability
notes: Battles the system can take before Power drops. Default 5, maximum 10.
